name: Pedro Tabuada convida Smile
description: Pedro Tabuada invites Smile for the R4W Remember Maré Alta Official Oporto After Hours party at Era uma vez no Porto.
longDescription:
Pedro Tabuada invites Smile for the R4W Remember Maré Alta Official Oporto After Hours session at Era uma vez no Porto.

The event takes place on 2 December 2026, starting at 23:59 at Rua da Madeira, 126. Admission is restricted to attendees aged 18 and over.
